title: Sorted search
statement: Start simple: Return the index of target in a sorted ascending array, or -1 when it is absent. The theory is optional. The C solution appears after the hidden tests pass.
constraints: Use the shrinking-range form of binary search.
think: A linear scan works but ignores the sort.
Keep a low and high bound and discard half each time.
Compute the midpoint without overflowing the index sum.
Stop when the range becomes empty.
hints: Maintain an inclusive low and high.
Move low to mid + 1 when the middle is too small.
Return -1 only after the bounds cross.
